candidates.name: candidate-a-restrained
candidates.purpose: Test whether colour beyond a functional floor adds useful scanning value. Holds chroma as low as WCAG floors and the distance matrix tolerate.

candidates.name: candidate-b-balanced
candidates.purpose: Baseline hypothesis: semantic colouration with a strong neutral foundation.

candidates.name: candidate-c-expressive
candidates.purpose: Test whether stronger unmistakable accents improve scanning enough to justify greater attention cost.

ordering_note: Candidates are listed in binding-file (alphabetical) order, which by convention is Restrained, Balanced, Expressive. This is NOT a ranking or a recommendation (DESIGN.md section 1).
disclaimer: All entries are CANDIDATE families. No aggregate score, winner, or recommendation is produced. Phase 7 (human evaluation) decides.
